template.title: Job shop instance {name}
template.statement: Schedule the operations of instance {name} so that each job's operations run in order, no machine runs two operations at once, and the makespan (the latest end) is as small as possible.
template.submission: Text file: one line per job: the start time of each of its operations, in order (integers); the instance file is fetched by fetch.sh into {file}; see checkers/jsp_check.py.

best_text: The best known makespan is {best} ({holder}); a valid schedule with a shorter makespan improves it.
bound_source: the best known lower bound in the keeper's archive (the larger of ScheduleOpt's and Shylo's)
holder_sources: the solver or publication of the archive's earliest entry with the best upper bound, or Shylo's reference where his upper bound is lower
open_rule: every instance whose best known lower bound is below its best known upper bound in the keeper's archive and, where O. Shylo's table lists it, there as well
left_out: 285 closed, 0 closed in Shylo's table, 31 zip only (of 376 instances)
